title: Agnus Dei (Josquin, Missa Veni Sancte Spiritus)
desc: Josquin des Prez, Missa Veni Sancte Spiritus, Agnus Dei. 5 voices (Superius, Altus, Tenor, Vagans, Bassus), each on its own staff. From the Josquin Research Project (josquin.stanford.edu, Jos0406e); encoded by Jesse Rodin. CC BY-NC 4.0. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve); coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff. No text in this edition.
